d:
Robert Greene, bestselling author of The 48 Laws of Power, on why being too nice makes you invisible and seduction is pure psychology.
He explains:
• Why seduction has nothing to do with looks and everything to do with psychology
• How to become more magnetic and attractive to others
• Why he believes being seen everywhere destroys your value faster than any mistake
• What the law of absence actually does to how people perceive your power
• Why being too nice to people makes you appear weak in any room
• How dark and transgressive traits secretly attract people even when they deny it
